title: Alida V NDE 3886
content: I was drowning and it was horrible, water was everywhere and I was desperately trying to breathe while at the same time grab onto the other child who had fallen into the swimming pool when our little raft overturned. I remember this whole scene was very ugly but at a certain point, it became beautiful with many beautiful colors. After the many different colors, there was something that I have not been able to recall. But I do remember perfectly the following, there was someone close by, I can't say who it was, and I was fascinated by the 'sun' that I saw shining overhead, it drew me towards it, it was irresistible, I wanted to go to the 'sun' but someone telepathically told me I couldn't. I thought that I was awake and that my body was still in this world, so I stopped for a moment and wondered why the 'sun' attracted me so, and why I couldn't go towards it. But at the same time I knew 'I don't know how' that I wasn't allowed to go to the 'sun'. So I decided to disobey that voice inside of me that told me I couldn't because the attraction was really too great. Then in a fraction of a second as I was attempting to go towards that light I was projected into my body and I heard some people who were telling me to throw up the water. As soon as I opened my eyes, I turned to search for the sun while I asked myself how in the world I had managed to open my eyes before since it was only at this time that I was seeing again. Suddenly the sun seemed so small and colorless; there was no comparison to what I had just seen before I returned to consciousness. This experience was so beautiful and I will carry it in my heart until I die. About ten years later I knew that other people have seen the same thing.<

arrival.other_being_detail: There was "someone close by" but she "can't say who it was."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in a swimming pool after a small raft overturned; she was trying to grab another child who had fallen in.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reported many beautiful colors before the 'sun'/light; then an unknown presence telepathically told her she couldn't go; she attempted to go anyway and was projected back into her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Distressing drowning scene shifted into beautiful colors, then an overhead 'sun'/light; telepathic prohibition; attempted movement toward light; immediate return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She described the light as a 'sun' shining overhead that irresistibly attracted her; after returning, the physical sun looked "so small and colorless" in comparison.

I was projected into my body"; "Suddenly the sun seemed so small and colorless; there was no comparison to what I had just seen".
